Interface PaymentMapper

All Known Implementing Classes:
PaymentMapperImpl
public interface PaymentMapper
Maps between Payment and PaymentRequestDto / PaymentResponseDto.

uses = RentalMapper.class delegates the Rental ↔ RentalRequestDto conversion to the dedicated mapper. Without this, MapStruct silently drops the nested rental field due to the field-name mismatch (entity field rental vs DTO field rental).
